claim: Deterministic guard regressions; these are not user gold accuracy evidence.

cases.historical_failure: A long generative result retained only its first block.
cases.invariant: All reference sentences contribute to omission_rate; incomplete output cannot silently pass.

cases.historical_failure: A short Japanese phrase repeated indefinitely.
cases.invariant: Four repeated 3-10 token n-grams are rejected before consensus.

cases.historical_failure: Output had no punctuation or only question-question artifacts.
cases.invariant: Punctuation precision/recall/PER report the defect separately without changing lexical text.

cases.historical_failure: All model tokens were attached to one time point.
cases.invariant: Zero/overlapping token spans produce structural_errors and are ineligible for ranking.

cases.historical_failure: Incorrect text was forced into an apparently precise timeline.
cases.invariant: Coverage/loop/language/text gates reject alignment and retain coarse timing.

cases.historical_failure: A word crossing a hard VAD split was truncated.
cases.invariant: Core spans cover every sample and both sides retain bounded overlap context.
